auth.tagline: Sort your people into balanced groups in seconds.
auth.name: Name
auth.invalid: That email or password isn't right.
auth.emailTaken: An account with that email already exists. Sign in instead.
auth.googleError: Couldn't sign in with Google. Try again.
auth.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Sign in again.

people.title: People
people.emptyBody: Add them one at a time or import an Excel file with everyone at once.
people.spouseHint: If their spouse is also on the list, they'll stay together when groups are made.
people.activeHint: Turn off if they're not coming this time.
people.deleteBody: They'll be removed from the list. Saved groupings won't change.
people.occasionalHint: Doesn't come often. Occasional people are spread across groups so none ends up short-handed.
people.coupleHint: Two people married to each other will be added: {a} and {b}. Fill in gender and age later in each one's details.
people.coupleCreated: {a} and {b} added as a married couple

import.title: Import from Excel
import.intro: Upload an .xlsx file with one person per row. The first row must contain the column names:
import.spouseTip: For married couples, enter the spouse's full name in “Spouse”. They'll always be linked so they stay together in groups; if the spouse has no row of their own, they're added to the list. You can also put both in one row, like “John and Mary”: they're split into two married people.
import.found: No people in the file | 1 person found | {n} people found
import.rowErrors: 1 row won't be imported | {n} rows won't be imported
import.replaceHint: Deletes your current {n} people before importing.
import.addedSpouses: Added to the list as spouses: {names}
import.invalidFile: Couldn't read the file. Make sure it's an Excel file (.xlsx).
import.noNameColumn: Couldn't find the “First name” column. Check the first row or use the template.

groups.title: Groups
groups.estimate: You'll get {groups} groups of {min} people | You'll get {groups} groups of {min} to {max} people
groups.balanceAgeHint: Only counts people whose age is set.
groups.resultHint: Select a person to move them to another group.
groups.noSetsBody: Choose the criteria in Create, give it a name and all your group sets will be here to view, adjust or export.
groups.regenerateBody: The same people will be shuffled again with the same criteria. Manual changes are lost and group names are kept by position only.
groups.groupNameHint: Leave it empty to use the default name.
groups.moveSpouseBody: {a} and {b} are married. You can take both to {group} or move only {a}.
groups.notEnough: You need at least 2 participants to make groups.
groups.emptyBody: Clustr sorts the people on your list into groups based on your criteria.
groups.deleteSetBody: This saved grouping will be deleted. People aren't affected.
groups.spreadOccasionalHint: So no group ends up short-handed if they don't come.
groups.head: Leader
groups.headsIntro: Choose a group: its people will lead the new groups, and everyone else will be split among them using this set’s criteria. A separate set is created; this one stays as it is.
groups.regenerateHeadsBody: Everyone else will be split again with the same criteria. Each leader keeps leading a group, with its name. Manual changes are lost.
groups.leadersHint: The first person in each group becomes its leader; if it’s a married couple, both do.
groups.headsKeepCouplesHint: A married couple in the chosen group leads one group together, and a leader’s spouse joins their group.
groups.headsSplitCouplesHint: Each person in the chosen group leads their own group, and married couples go to different groups.

profile.title: Profile
profile.name: Name
profile.setPasswordHint: So you can also sign in with your email, not just Google.
profile.deleteAllBody: Your list will be emptied. Saved groupings are kept. This can't be undone.
profile.deleteAccountBody: Your account, people and groupings will be deleted. This can't be undone.
